title: TranscriptEvent
description: The canonical append-only fact shape for official agents. Field names are frozen to binder ch09 (ADR-0095 fork resolution 1): agentNodeId, bodyId, payloadJson, payloadBlobRefs, redactionState, retentionPolicyId. The ch03 stream-event variant (agentId, body, blobRefs, redaction, retention) is superseded. (sessionId, sequence) is unique and monotonic in daemon receive order; contentHash/prevHash form a per-session tamper-evident chain.

sessionId.description: Non-null for official events. Unjoinable imports stay observed; never invent a session.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing per session in daemon receive order.

kind.description: Open string for tolerant reading. Known families (transcript-receipt packet): lifecycle (agent_registered, body_attached, session_started, heartbeat, context_pressure, turn_end, session_end, body_stopped), conversation (operator_message, system_guidance, assistant_delta, assistant_message, reasoning_summary, thinking_exposed), tool/shell (tool_call, tool_result, shell_command, stdout_chunk, stderr_chunk, mcp_call, mcp_result), files/git (file_read, file_write, file_diff, file_touch, git_action, commit_created, pr_opened, check_updated, merge_queue_updated), governance (tool_preflight, tool_denied, approval_request, approval_result, capability_lease_issued, capability_lease_revoked), coordination (claim_update, parley_event, blackboard_item, inbox_message, tube_message, skill_graft, memory_retrieval), cost (cost_accrued, budget_warning, budget_pause, budget_cancelled), continuation (checkpoint, compaction_packet, successor_created, continuation_started), receipts (receipt_started, receipt_completed, receipt_verified, receipt_failed), errors (adapter_error, provider_error, transcript_gap, retention_failure).

idempotencyKey.description: Required for importers, reconnecting streams, and remote mirrors.

payloadJson.description: Structured metadata and small text. Provider-specific fields live here or under source.

payloadBlobRefs.description: stdout, stderr, full diffs, screenshots, recordings, long tool results. Refs record media type, byte count, content hash, redaction state, storage tier.

truncated.description: Truncation preserves original byte count and hash so receipts can mark evidence partial.

contentHash.description: Hash of the canonical event body excluding contentHash.

prevHash.description: Previous persisted event hash for the same session; null for the first event.
